title: StudioApproveResult
description: The answer to Approve (2.17.0). Since 2.18.0 it may say which version is meant: approving a draft of a published version or a changed master. The Worker (0f38200) does not send these two yet.

noop.description: True when it was already approved with the same hash.

version.description: Optional (2.18.0): the version the approval is for; for a draft, the version Publish will make live.

draft.description: Optional (2.18.0): true when what was approved is a draft beside a published version.
